## Experience

### AI Engineer — QualtechEdge (current)
- Built FRIDA, a config-driven agent runtime: a drag-and-drop canvas compiles user workflow configs into LangGraph state graphs (input → LLM → router → tool execution / RAG → output).
- Runtime infrastructure: provider-agnostic LLM calls, tool middleware, Postgres checkpointing for pause/resume sessions across text and voice.
- Multilingual LiveKit voice agents with Sarvam AI (Indic STT/TTS), AWS deployment, observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse), DeepEval evaluation.
- Also shipped: Basil (DeepAgents multi-agent system that builds FRIDA workflows from natural language), Zeus (context-driven FRIDA variant on LangChain), and a Lip-Sync service for cross-team use (lip movement tracking, multi-user presence, fraud signals).

### Prompt Engineer — Outlier AI (Mar 2025 – May 2025, freelance)
- Designed and optimized LLM prompts across structured tasks; evaluated AI outputs for accuracy and consistency.

### Software Engineer (Intern) — Microsoft (Jun 2024 – Aug 2024)
- Built an audio creation panel for Microsoft Designer using React and Fluent UI v9, enabling audio generation and MP4 export.
- Delivered accessible, WCAG-compliant UI components for production use.
